maddeler.e:
ننتور (form VIII)
# نَنْتَوِرُ (nantawiru) /nan.ta.wi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَوَرَ (intawara)
# نَنْتَوِرَ (nantawira) /nan.ta.wi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَوَرَ (intawara)
# نَنْتَوِرْ (nantawir) /nan.ta.wir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْتَوَرَ (intawara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
